subject.title: fix(infra): use || for empty socket path/token fallback in mergeExecApprovalsSocketDefaults

question: Should `mergeExecApprovalsSocketDefaults` deliberately support raw blank socket fields outside the canonical normalization boundary, or should this PR be withdrawn as unreachable defensive behavior?
rationale: Current supported callers normalize both incoming and persisted data before the helper, while the proposed behavior creates a new fallback contract for direct raw inputs.

options.title: Keep canonical normalization only
options.body: Ask the contributor to withdraw this branch unless they can identify a supported caller that reaches the helper with raw blanks.

options.title: Adopt a raw-helper contract
options.body: Accept the hardening only with owner confirmation that future or external callers may intentionally invoke the helper with unnormalized persisted data.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical normalization only
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to withdraw this branch unless they can identify a supported caller that reaches the helper with raw blanks.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to the gateway and node-host set paths whose normalization invariant determines whether the proposed helper contract is needed.
